تنازلت (form VI)
# تَنَازَلْتُ (tanāzaltu) /ta.naː.zal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَنَازَلَ (tanāzala)
# تَنَازَلْتَ (tanāzalta) /ta.naː.zal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَازَلَ (tanāzala)
# تَنَازَلْتِ (tanāzalti) /ta.naː.zal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَازَلَ (tanāzala)
# تَنَازَلَتْ (tanāzalat) /ta.naː.za.lat/: third-person fem
